answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 15890 Country: India Title: if som1 left intentionallly fast of ramazan for 20 days the kaffara shoud 1200 days continous fast or 60 days,does it apply sor 2 or 3 days also Question: if som1 left intentionallly fast of ramazan for 20 days the kaffara shoud 1200 days continous fast or 60 days,does it apply sor 2 or 3 days also Answer ID: 15890 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1537/1456=B=1430) You have neither to keep 1200 fasts nor 60 fasts. It is sufficient to keep 20 fasts with the intention of qadha. If one misses 2-3 fasts, the same rule will be applied i.e. he will have to make qadha of 2-3 days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
